exact_statement: For every Boolean seed g on n>=1 uniform bits and k>=2 fresh bits, N=n+k, let F(x,z)=g(x)(-1)^{1[wt(x,z)<=1]}. Put D0=sum_i 1[g(0)!=g(e_i)] and D1=sum_{i!=j} 1[g(e_j)!=g(e_i+e_j)]. Then I(F)=I(g)+2^{1-N}[N(N-1)-2kD0-2D1]. Any deterministic finite r-bit summary E(z) from which the entire fresh-block residual row is decodable satisfies sum_j I(E_j)>=k^2*2^{1-k}; no such summary exists for r=1 and equality is attainable for every r>=2. For g=-1 only at 00, I(F_k)=1+(k^2-k+2)*2^{-k-1}, H(F_k)>1 for every k>=32, and H(F_k)->2. Hence H(F_k)/(inf_E sum_j I(E_j)) tends to infinity but H(F_k)/I(F_k)->2. This refutes only universal payment of total entropy from fresh-summary influence alone, not FEI.

exact_statement: Let x,z be independent finite uniform physical blocks, S(z) any deterministic summary with r active states of probabilities p_s>0, and F(x,z)=h_{S(z)}(x), with arbitrary Boolean sign rows h_s. Define e_s=1[S=s]/sqrt(p_s) and E_s as the complete squared-Fourier entropy of this normalized real function, all entropies in bits. With R=sum_s p_s H(h_s), H(F)<=R+r H(p)+r sum_s p_s E_s. More sharply H(F)<=H(m)+sum_A m_A r_A H(q_A), where m_A=sum_s p_s hhat_s(A)^2, Q(A,B)=sum_s hhat_s(A)^2 bhat_s(B)^2 is normalized, q_A=Q(A,.)/m_A on positive rows, and r_A counts nonzero hhat_s(A). If one state has mass1-epsilon, H(F)<=R+2r H(p)+2rk epsilon. The coefficient1 on R is sharp even for the A092 three-distinct-row prime-edit family: the overhead tends to0 and H(F),R tend to the same positive seed entropy. Physical influence is exactly I_x(F)=sum_s p_s I(h_s), I_z(F)=2^(1-k) sum_{undirected z edges} Pr_x[h_{S(z)}(x)!=h_{S(z')} (x)], with k the z dimension. Thus supplied row bounds H(h_s)<=C I(h_s) yield H(F)<=C I_x(F)+r H(p)+r sum_s p_s E_s, but no influence payment of the dictionary or arbitrary original row source is asserted. Correlated outputs, repeated row functions, constants, dummy coordinates, omitted zero-probability states and zero spectral marginals are covered.
